name: CRM - Support Ticket Assignment

parameters.query: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_tickets (customer_id, title, description, priority, status, sla_deadline) SELECT NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid, COALESCE(NULLIF($2::text, ''), 'Hỗ trợ khách hàng'), $3, COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''), 'P3'), 'OPEN', NOW() + INTERVAL '2 days' WHERE NULLIF($1::text, '') IS NOT NULL RETURNING id), unassign AS (UPDATE {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_tickets SET assignee_id = NULL, assignee_name = 'Chưa gán', updated_at = NOW() WHERE NULLIF($1::text, '') IS NULL AND NULLIF($5::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id = NULLIF($5::text, '')::uuid AND status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM ins UNION ALL SELECT id FROM unassign;
